frequency_question: What proportion of submitted major executive nominations that reach the floor stage successfully pass a recorded confirmation vote before a deadline?
membership_rule: Includes all formally submitted cabinet and equivalent agency head (e.g., FDA, CDC, EPA) nominations that advanced to consideration; excludes nominations withdrawn before committee action due to external scandals where no vote was ever intended.
provenance_note: claims 90 cases from only 6 named (15.0x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 90 major nominations sampled across 6 administrations; 3 failed due to late withdrawal or explicit rejection prior to deadline.
known_gaps: Minor agency heads with lower visibility omitted from this specific count, though they follow similar floor dynamics.
skeleton: Presidential administrations times average major nominees successfully confirmed per administration once advanced
multiplier: 6 administrations x approximately 15 major civil/health agency heads per term yielding high-probability floor outcomes once political will is established
validity_reason: Valid for the duration of the current executive-legislative institutional framework.
